title: Branchless Signed Min / Max
constraints: `mn = min(a, b)` and `mx = max(a, b)` for **signed** 8-bit values.
**Branchless:** no `?:`, `if` or `case`, and no comparison operators (`<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `$signed` compares included).
hints: The sign of a − b says which one is smaller, but 8-bit subtraction overflows. Subtract in 9 bits (sign-extend both).
Turn the 'a < b' bit into a mask m (all ones or all zeros).
`mn = b ^ ((a ^ b) & m)` selects a when m is all ones: XOR swapping instead of a mux.

forbidden.message: branchless: no if, case, when or select
no comparison operators (<, >, <=, >=): only shifts << >> >>> are allowed
